lines.text: The LORD says the land is destroyed because the people forsook His law and went after the Baals.
The LORD will feed the people wormwood and scatter them among nations they have never known.
The LORD tells the people to summon the most skillful wailing women so their eyes overflow with tears.
Death climbs through the windows and cuts off the young men from the city gates.
The wise man should not boast in wisdom, the strong in strength, or the wealthy in land.
